info.title: Xero Finance API
info.description: The Finance API is a collection of endpoints which customers can use in the course of a loan application, which may assist lenders to gain the confidence they need to provide capital.

get.description: Summarizes the total cash position for each account for an org

parameters.name: balanceDate
parameters.description:
date, yyyy-MM-dd 

If no parameter is provided, the current date will be used.

The ‘balance date’ will return transactions based on the accounting date entered by the user.  Transactions before the balanceDate will be included.
The user has discretion as to which accounting period the transaction relates to.

The ‘balance date’  will control the latest maximum date of transactions included in the aggregate numbers.  Balance date does not affect the CurrentStatement object, as this will always return the most recent statement before asAtSystemDate (if specified)

parameters.name: asAtSystemDate
parameters.description:
date, yyyy-MM-dd 

If no parameter is provided, the current date will be used.

The ‘as at’ date will return transactions based on the  creation date.  It reflects the date the transactions were entered into Xero, not the accounting date.
The ‘as at’ date can not be overridden by the user.  This can be used to estimate a ‘historical frequency of reconciliation’.

The ‘as at’ date will affect the current statement in the response, as any candidate statements created after this date will be filtered out.  Thus the current statement returned will be the most recent statement prior to the specified ‘as at’ date.  Be aware that neither the begin date, nor the balance date, will affect the current statement.

Note;  information is only presented when system architecture allows, meaning historical cash validation information will be an estimate. In addition, delete events are not aware of the ‘as at’ functionality in this endpoint, meaning that transactions deleted at the time the API is accessed will be considered to always have been deleted

parameters.name: beginDate
parameters.description:
date, yyyy-MM-dd 

If no parameter is provided, the aggregate results will be drawn from the user’s total history.

The ‘begin date’ will return transactions based on the accounting date entered by the user. Transactions after the beginDate will be included.
The user has discretion as to which accounting period the transaction relates to

get.description: The revenue by contact report provides a year to date profit and loss for customers and suppliers for a given organisation, including detailed contact information.

parameters.name: contactIds
parameters.description:
Specifies the customer contacts to be included in the report.

If no parameter is provided, all customer contacts will be included

parameters.name: includeManualJournals
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include the manual journals in the report.
            
If no parameter is provided, manual journals will not be included

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description:
Date yyyy-MM-dd

Specifies the start date for the report.
            
If no parameter is provided, the date of 12 months before the end date will be used.
            
It is recommended to always specify both a start date and end date; While the initial range may be set to 12 months, this may need to be reduced for high volume organisations in order to improve latency

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description:
Date yyyy-MM-dd

Specifies the end date for the report.

If no parameter is provided, the current date will be used.
            
It is recommended to always specify both a start date and end date; While the initial range may be set to 12 months, this may need to be reduced for high volume organisations in order to improve latency

get.description: For lenders that prefer using bank statement data as the source of truth.  We provide a data point that will allow access to customer bank statements, plus for reconciled bank transactions the matching accounting, invoice and billing data as well.  As customers reconcile bank statements to invoices and bills, this transaction detail will provide valuable insight for lender's assessment measures.

parameters.name: BankAccountID
parameters.description:
string, GUID

Bank account Id

parameters.name: FromDate
parameters.description:
date, yyyy-MM-dd 

Specifies the start date of the query period. 
The maximum range of the query period is 12 months. If the specified query period is more than 12 months the request will be rejected

parameters.name: ToDate
parameters.description:
date, yyyy-MM-dd 

Specifies the end date of the query period. 
If the end date is a future date, the request will be rejected

parameters.name: SummaryOnly
parameters.description:
boolean, true/false

The default value is true if no parameter is provided.

In summary mode, the response will exclude the computation-heavy LineItems fields from bank transaction, invoice, credit note, prepayment and overpayment data, making the API calls quicker and more efficient

total.description: Total of Invoice tax inclusive (i.e. SubTotal + TotalTax); Not included in summary mode

type.description: The DEBIT or CREDIT status of the account. Cash accounts in credit have a negative balance

value.description: Total closing balance of the account. This includes both reconciled and unreconciled bank statement lines. The closing balance will always be represented as a positive number, with it’s debit/credit status defined in the statementBalanceDebitCredit field

accounts.description: Refer to the accounts section below

cashflowActivities.description: Break down of cash and cash equivalents for the period

total.description: Total value of the activity type

name.description: Name of the cashflow activity type. It will be either Operating Activities, Investing Activities or Financing Activities

total.description: Total movement on this account type

accounts.description: A list of the movement on each account detail during the query period. Refer to the account detail element below

title.description: Name of this account type, it will be either Trading Income or Other Income for Revenue section / Direct Cost or Operating Expenses for Expense section

entryType.description: Sign (Debit/Credit) of the movement of balance in the account

value.description: Net movement or net balance in the account

date.description: Date the payment is being made (YYYY-MM-DD) e.g. 2009-09-06

bankAmount.description: The bank amount of the payment

batchPaymentId.description: Xero Identifier of batch payment. Present if the payment was created as part of a batch

currencyRate.description: Exchange rate when payment is received. Only used for non base currency invoices and credit notes e.g. 0.7500

endDate.description: Looking at the most recent bank statement, this field indicates the last date which transactions on this statement pertain to. This date is represented in ISO 8601 format

endBalance.description: Looking at the most recent bank statement, this field indicates the balance after the transactions on the statement are applied (note, this is not always populated by the bank in every single instance (~10%))

importedDateTimeUtc.description: Looking at the most recent bank statement, this field indicates when the document was imported into Xero.  This date is represented in ISO 8601 format

importSourceType.description: Looking at the most recent bank statement, this field indicates the source of the data (direct bank feed, file upload, or manual keying)

startDate.description: Looking at the most recent bank statement, this field indicates the first date which transactions on this statement pertain to. This date is represented in ISO 8601 format

startBalance.description: Looking at the most recent bank statement, this field indicates the balance before the transactions on the statement are applied (note, this is not always populated by the bank in every single instance (~10%))

accountClass.description: The class of the account. See Account Class Types

accountType.description: The type of the account. See Account Types

reportingCode.description: Reporting code used for cash flow classification

totalCredited.description: Total credited value for the contact

totalVoided.description: Total voided value for the contact

transactionCount.description: Number of transactions for the contact

totalOutstandingAged.description: Total outstanding invoice value for the contact within the period where the invoices are more than 90 days old

accountTypes.description: Contains trading income and other income for revenue section / operating expenses and direct cost for expense section if the data is available for each section. Refer to the account type element below

total.description: Total value of all the accounts in this type

accountType.description: The type of the account. See Account Types

accounts.description: A list of all accounts of this type. Refer to the Account section below for each account element detail

accountType.description: The type of the account. See Account Types

payments.description: List of payments associated with reconciled statement lines

postedDate.description: Date of when statement line was posted

isDeleted.description: Boolean to show if statement line is deleted

isDuplicate.description: Boolean to show if statement line is duplicate

bankTransactions.description: List of bank transactions associated with reconciled statement lines

totalCreditedUnApplied.description: Total unapplied credited value for the contact within the period

totalOutstanding.description: Total outstanding invoice value for the contact within the period

totalPaid.description: Total paid invoice and cash value for the contact within the period

lineItems.description: The LineItems element can contain any number of individual LineItem sub-elements. Not included in summary mode

batchPaymentId.description: Xero Identifier of batch payment. Present if the transaction is part of a batch

total.description: Total of Invoice tax inclusive (i.e. SubTotal + TotalTax); Not included in summary mode

accountId.description: The Xero identifier for an account

statementBalanceDate.description: UTC Date when the last bank statement item was entered into Xero. This date is represented in ISO 8601 format

latestUnreconciledTransaction.description: UTC Date which is the latest transaction date of a statement line for which the reconciled flag is set to FALSE.  This date is represented in ISO 8601 format

reconciledAmountNeg.description: Sum of the amounts of all statement lines where both the reconciled flag is set to TRUE, and the amount is negative

totalAmountNeg.description: Sum of the amounts of all statement lines where the amount is negative

reconciledAmountPos.description: Sum of the amounts of all statement lines where both the reconciled flag is set to TRUE, and the amount is positive

totalAmountPos.description: Sum of the amounts of all statement lines where the amount is positive

avgDaysUnreconciledPos.description: Sum-product of age of statement line in days multiplied by transaction amount, divided by the sum of transaction amount - in for those statement lines in which the reconciled flag is set to FALSE, and the amount is positive. Provides an indication of the age of unreconciled transactions

avgDaysUnreconciledNeg.description: Sum-product of age of statement line in days multiplied by transaction amount, divided by the sum of transaction amount - in for those statement lines in which the reconciled flag is set to FALSE, and the amount is negative. Provides an indication of the age of unreconciled transactions

earliestUnreconciledTransaction.description: UTC Date which is the earliest transaction date of a statement line for which the reconciled flag is set to FALSE.  This date is represented in ISO 8601 format

deletedAmount.description: Sum of the amounts of all deleted statement lines.  Transactions may be deleted due to duplication or otherwise

totalAmount.description: Sum of the amounts of all statement lines.  This is used as a metric of comparison to the unreconciled figures above

earliestReconciledTransaction.description: UTC Date which is the earliest transaction date of a statement line for which the reconciled flag is set to TRUE.  This date is represented in ISO 8601 format

reconciledLines.description: Count of all statement lines where the reconciled flag is set to TRUE

unreconciledAmountPos.description: Sum of the amounts of all statement lines where both the reconciled flag is set to FALSE, and the amount is positive

unreconciledAmountNeg.description: Sum of the amounts of all statement lines where both the reconciled flag is set to FALSE, and the amount is negative

unreconciledLines.description: Count of all statement lines where the reconciled flag is set to FALSE

latestReconciledTransaction.description: UTC Date which is the latest transaction date of a statement line for which the reconciled flag is set to TRUE.  This date is represented in ISO 8601 format

totalOutstandingAged.description: Total outstanding invoice value within the period where the invoices are more than 90 days old

signedMovement.description: Value of movement. Expense and Asset accounts code debits as positive. Revenue, Liability, and Equity accounts code debits as negative

total.description: Total value of all the accounts in this type

netCashMovement.description: Net movement of cash and cash equivalents for the period

openingCashBalance.description: Opening balance of cash and cash equivalents

closingCashBalance.description: Closing balance of cash and cash equivalents

bankAccountCurrencyCode.description: Currency code of the bank account

statements.description: List of bank statements and linked accounting data for the requested period

contactId.description:
ID of the contact associated with the transactions.

Transactions with no contact will be grouped under the special ID: 86793108-198C-46D8-90A3-43C1D12686CE.

Transactions that are receive or spend bank transfers will be grouped under the special ID: 207322B3-6A58-4BE7-80F1-430123914AD6

name.description:
Name of the contact associated with the transactions.

If no contact is associated with the transactions this will appear as “None Provided”,

For receive or spend bank transfer transactions, this will appear as “Bank Transfer”

accountCodes.description: A list of account codes involved in transactions

indicativeEndBalance.description: Closing statement balance calculated in Xero (= bank account conversion balance plus sum of imported bank statement lines). Note: If indicative statement balance doesn't match imported statement balance for the same date, either the conversion (opening at inception) balance in Xero is wrong or there's an error in the bank statement lines in Xero. Ref: https://central.xero.com/s/article/Compare-the-statement-balance-in-Xero-to-your-actual-bank-balance?userregion=true

endBalance.description: Closing balance sourced from imported bank statements (if supplied). Note, for manually uploaded statements, this balance is also manual and usually not supplied. Where not supplied, the value will be 0

importSource.description: Identifies where the statement data in Xero was sourced, 1) direct bank feed, automatically loaded from the bank (eg STMTIMPORTSRC/CBAFEED); 2) indirect bank feed, automatically loaded from a 3rd party provider (eg STMTIMPORTSRC/YODLEE); 3) manually uploaded bank feed (eg STMTIMPORTSRC/CSV) or 4) manually entered statement data (STMTIMPORTSRC/MANUAL)

importedDateTimeUtc.description: Utc date time of when the statement was imported in Xero

startBalance.description: Opening balance sourced from imported bank statements (if supplied). Note, for manually uploaded statements, this balance is also manual and usually not supplied. Where not supplied, the value will be 0

indicativeStartBalance.description: Opening statement balance calculated in Xero (= bank account conversion balance plus sum of imported bank statement lines). Note: If indicative statement balance doesn't match imported statement balance for the same date, either the conversion (opening at inception) balance in Xero is wrong or there's an error in the bank statement lines in Xero. Ref: https://central.xero.com/s/article/Compare-the-statement-balance-in-Xero-to-your-actual-bank-balance?userregion=true

signedBalance.description: Value of balance. Expense and Asset accounts code debits as positive. Revenue, Liability, and Equity accounts code debits as negative

accountCode.description: Customer defined alpha numeric account code e.g 200 or SALES

accountClass.description: The class of the account. See Account Class Types

accountType.description: The type of the account. See Account Types

status.description: Accounts with a status of ACTIVE can be updated to ARCHIVED. See Account Status Codes

total.description: Total of Invoice tax inclusive (i.e. SubTotal + TotalTax); Not included in summary mode

totalCreditedUnApplied.description: Total unapplied credited value within the period

totalOutstanding.description: Total outstanding invoice value within the period

totalPaid.description: Total paid invoice and cash value within the period

accounts.description: List of the accounts in this activity

This could be from a bank or aggregator.   This gives an indication on the certainty of correctness of the data.  Only negative transactions are included

This could be from a bank or aggregator.  This gives an indication on the certainty of correctness of the data.  Only positive transactions are included
